$meta.name: AZMX Brand API
$meta.description: Versioned, programmatic API providing structured access to AZMX brand rules, design tokens, voice guidelines, and audience personas

endpoints.name: Design Tokens
endpoints.description: Complete set of 587 design tokens across 6 collections (primitives, palette modes, semantic light/dark, component, canvas, RTL)

data_structure.1b. Palette: 19 tokens × 6 mode(s) (Blue, Orange, Green, Yellow, Purple, Red)

endpoints.name: Color Palettes
endpoints.description: 6 brand color palettes: Blue with its 12-step ramp, plus 5 secondary palettes with signature, deep, and text-safe values

data_structure.palettes: 6 palettes (Blue, Orange, Green, Yellow, Purple, Red)
data_structure.blue_ramp: 12 steps (Blue 50 to Blue 1000), each with hex and usage notes
data_structure.secondary: 5 palettes with signature, deep, text_safe_step and text_safe_hex; full ramps live in tokens.json

endpoints.name: Typography System
endpoints.description: Font families, weights, type scale, and typographic rules for the AZMX brand

data_structure.families: 2 font families (thmanyah serif display, Azm X Variable)
data_structure.weights: 7 weights (ExtraLight, Light, Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold, Black)
data_structure.type_scale: 16 roles with size, line height, weight, tracking (px) and case
data_structure.rules: 4 usage rules plus a bilingual note

endpoints.name: Voice & Tone Guidelines
endpoints.description: Brand language, tone rules, voice dimensions, writing mechanics, and format-specific guidelines

endpoints.name: Audience Personas
endpoints.description: 8 audience personas with pain points, core messages, motions, and brand associations

data_structure.personas: 8 personas (Directors / Heads, Leads, C-Suite, Product / UX Heads, Operations, Researchers, Designers, Industry Professionals)
data_structure.brands: 5 brands (AZM X, Colab, Majarah, Clix, Anatomi)

endpoints.name: Content Prompt Templates
endpoints.description: 15 content generation prompt templates with full template text

data_structure.prompts: 15 prompts, each with id, number, title, description, deck_page, template, notes
data_structure.titles: The Blog SEO Brief Prompt, The Article Generation Prompt, The Case Study Generation Prompt, The Email Newsletter Prompt, The Internal Memo/Announcement Prompt, The Press Release Prompt, The Event Invitation Prompt, The Content Customization Prompt: LinkedIn, The Content Customization Prompt: Instagram, The Content Customization Prompt: Twitter/X, The WhatsApp Message Template, The Content Localization Prompt: English to Arabic, The Report Generation Prompt, The Video Script Prompt, The Presentation Talking Points Prompt

endpoints.name: Brand Image Library
endpoints.description: 242 catalogued brand images, each with three concept tags

usage.versioning: API version in URL path (/v1/). Breaking changes will increment version number.

examples.code:
import requests
response = requests.get('https://gamaleldientarek.github.io/azmx-brand/api/v1/audiences.json')
audiences = response.json()
for persona in audiences['personas']:
    print(f"{persona['name']}: {persona['core_message']}")
